declared: 2026-10-30, WP-11 Phase H follow-up, before any v1b run (no Native run of the 8-episode plan exists at declaration)
description: Multi-episode reliability checks of the cutting_research_v1 policy-ready env (supplement Test F). POLICY_READY is set only if every check of every episode passes and every stored episode validates with the dataset reader.

memory.note: Least-squares slope of the post-episode host RSS / process GPU memory over episodes >= fit_from_episode (episode 0 includes one-time kernel compilation and caches).

determinism.same_seed_same_controller_gpu_or_live: verdict identical; reported metrics compared, not gated

amendment: No gate or threshold changes: every key used by dataset.reliability_report (minimum_consecutive_episodes, reset, clock, camera, memory, determinism, episodes) is copied unchanged from phaseG_reliability_v1a, so the v1a and v1b verdicts of the same run must be identical (a difference is a scoring bug, not a result). v1b adds (a) a declared longer Native run (run, below) so the memory trends are fitted on 7 points instead of the 3 of the Phase H rerun, and (b) an exact statement of the memory trend estimator for N episodes, which v1a already fixes (fit_from_episode 1, ordinary least squares) but does not spell out.

memory_estimator.status: declared before the run; gating; identical to the v1a / dataset.reliability_report implementation (src/robotic_cutting_sim/dataset.py _slope)
memory_estimator.samples: one sample per stored episode, taken by scripts/collect_dataset.py after the episode is evaluated, returned home, recorded and exported (episode.json memory_after)
memory_estimator.host_value: memory_after.host_rss_mib = VmRSS of the collector process from /proc/<pid>/status, MiB
memory_estimator.gpu_value: memory_after.gpu_used_mib_total = sum over GPUs of nvidia-smi --query-compute-apps used_memory for the collector pid, MiB (this process only; other jobs on the GPU are not counted)
memory_estimator.fit_episodes: episodes fit_from_episode .. N-1 = 1..7 for the declared 8-episode run (episode 0 is excluded as v1/v1a already allow: one-time kernel compilation, caches and the only Kit open_stage); 7 points
memory_estimator.abscissa: x = 0, 1, ..., M-1 in episode order over the fitted episodes (unit spacing = one episode); samples that are None are dropped before the fit (as _slope does)
memory_estimator.slope: numpy.polyfit(x, y, 1)[0]: unweighted ordinary least squares, MiB per episode; no outlier rejection, no smoothing, no alternative estimator gates
memory_estimator.gates: host slope <= memory.host_rss_slope_max_mib_per_episode (64); GPU slope <= memory.gpu_slope_max_mib_per_episode (32)
memory_estimator.diagnostics_not_gating: reported alongside, never used for a verdict: Theil-Sen median slope over the same points, the OLS slope over episodes 1..3 only (comparable to the Phase H 4-episode rerun), last-minus-first of the fitted points, and the per-episode deltas

run.plan: configs/wp11/phaseH/native_reliability_trim_v1b_8ep.json (8 episodes = the Phase G/H Native Test F plan cycled twice; fixed seed 42)
run.runtime: isaac_sim (Native), one process for all 8 episodes (no process recycling)
run.runtime_profile: full_physics_v1 (formal 1 mm / 4 mm / 0.1 ms / 20 ms; native.stage_reset = reload_in_place)
run.collector_flags: --camera-every 5 --record-every 10 --profile stages (as the Phase H rerun native_reliability_trim_full_physics_001)
run.scoring: --reliability-config configs/wp11/phaseG_reliability_v1b.json (primary) --reliability-config configs/wp11/phaseG_reliability_v1a.json --reliability-config configs/wp11/phaseG_reliability_v1.json; all three reported
run.source: a fresh git worktree pinned at the commit that adds this file (git_dirty = false)
run.gpu_rule: launch only on a GPU with <= 2 other active compute jobs and >= 12 GB free; at most one Isaac job of this agent; the chosen GPU is recorded
run.disk_rule: >= 15 GB free on /mnt/data; completed runtime grasp-trace JSONL files may be gzip-compressed losslessly while the run proceeds (sha256 of each original recorded); dataset files read by read_dataset.py are not touched
run.failure_policy: failed episodes are kept, scored and reported; no rerun with changed settings; a single relaunch (to native_reliability_v1b_002) only for an infrastructure crash before the first episode's physics
run.verdict: the Native POLICY_READY verdict is the v1b POLICY_READY of this run; v1a must agree; v1 is reported for continuity (its tool_at_rest_after_reset rule is expected to fail from the known PhysX clamp jitter)
